payment_disputes_withdrawal_ck.name: payment_disputes_withdrawal_ck
payment_disputes_withdrawal_ck.value:
withdrawn_from_credit_cents >= 0 and withdrawn_to_debt_cents >= 0
          and withdrawn_from_credit_cents + withdrawn_to_debt_cents in (0, amount_cents)

payment_disputes_order_ck.name: payment_disputes_order_ck
payment_disputes_order_ck.value: reinstated_at is null or withdrawn_at is not null

payment_refunds_reversal_ck.name: payment_refunds_reversal_ck
payment_refunds_reversal_ck.value:
reversed_from_credit_cents >= 0 and reversed_to_debt_cents >= 0
          and reversed_from_credit_cents + reversed_to_debt_cents in (0, amount_cents)

payment_refunds_order_ck.name: payment_refunds_order_ck
payment_refunds_order_ck.value: restored_at is null or clawed_back_at is not null

org_invitations_org_email_open_key.name: org_invitations_org_email_open_key
org_invitations_org_email_open_key.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null
